name: Vermont
about: Peak fall foliage (early-to-mid Oct) is Vermont's single busiest, most booked-out stretch; winter (Dec–Feb) brings real skiing at Stowe and Killington, and April's 'mud season' is the genuine off-season.
overview: Some of America's best fall foliage, real Northeast ski resorts, maple syrup country, and the country's oldest long-distance hiking trail — small-town New England at its most classic.
costOverview: Small-town Vermont stays reasonable outside peak weekends — foliage season and ski-resort towns like Stowe are where prices climb hardest.
